about: TAPEWARD rules: single source of truth for rounds and scoring. The server reads this file; deploy.sh copies it to web/rules.json.

market_hours_utc.note: US standard time (DST ends Sun 1 Nov 2026)

pick.replace: a new signature for the same (round, wallet, slot) replaces the old one until picks close; signedAt must grow

slots.holder_check: balanceOf(wallet) >= holder_min tokens at request time, re-checked at picks close for extra slots

scoring.basket_bp: equal-weight mean of each feed's (end - start) / start, in basis points, rounded toward zero
scoring.start: latest Chainlink round with updatedAt <= lock
scoring.end: latest Chainlink round with updatedAt <= score time
scoring.side_rule: side right = sign of the actual spread; a 0 spread gives nobody the 100
scoring.ties: earlier signedAt wins, then lower address

anchor.first: as soon as a round has its first leaves (within one 5 s tick), then at most once per UTC hour while the leaf set changes
anchor.final: at picks close (+ <= 60 s), before lock
anchor.leaf: keccak256(bytes.concat(keccak256(abi.encode(bytes32 round, address picker, uint8 slot, uint8 side, int32 spreadBp, uint64 signedAt))))

house_desk.name: TAPEWARD desk
house_desk.rule: RED if the RED basket beat the BLUE basket over the last 5 trading sessions, else BLUE; spread = that 5-session spread / 5 for daily rounds, the full 5-session spread for Election Night; clamped to +-2000 bp
